persistent_fetch_failure.title: SA EzyCheck is unreachable
persistent_fetch_failure.description: SA EzyCheck has failed to fetch data for {threshold} consecutive attempts for "{entry_title}". This may be a temporary outage or a network problem. No action is needed if it resolves on its own; if it persists, check your network connection and the service's status.
